7 dead in coal mine accident in China's Shanxi

TAIYUAN, March 15 (Xinhua) -- As the search and rescue operation has ended, all the seven miners who were trapped in an accident in an underground warehouse of a coal mine in north China's Shanxi Province were confirmed dead, local authorities said.
The accident happened on Monday at the coal mine of the Taoyuan Xinlong coal industrial corporation in Zhongyang County, according to the county government. ■
